_about: Guideline registry: the current version of each guideline the rules cite. When a guideline committee learns of a new edition, it updates 'current' here; every rule citing an older edition is then flagged on governance.html for specialist re-review. 'accepted' records a specialist's documented decision that a rule may keep citing the older edition (rule id -> reason). Checked 2026-10-08; versions are listed only where the current edition is certain.
